scenario: Structure a free-text HbA1c lab result into a valid FHIR R4 Observation.
instruction: Generate a valid FHIR R4 Observation resource for the HbA1c result of 7.2% described in the clinical note. Use LOINC code 4548-4, status final, laboratory category, effectiveDateTime 2026-05-20, subject Patient/pat-001, encounter Encounter/enc-001, and a UCUM valueQuantity of 7.2 percent. Respond with only the JSON object {"resource": { ... }}.
